source_witnesses.title: Lent and Holy Week in the Home
source_witnesses.host: CatholicCulture excerpts on seven separate activity pages

methodology: Abstract concrete attested/recommended actions from located online paragraphs; several different components may come from one paragraph and MUST NOT be added as distinct customs. Do not confuse the two later family-guidance sources with pre-1962 historical witnesses. Liturgical ceremonies, invented household prayer rites, legal/disciplinary assertions, and symbolic reenactments are recorded as context or proposals only. No printed page locators invented. No long recipes/prayers/music reproduced.
